Resolve Ambiguity

Resolve Ambiguity workflow for coding agents. Use when a required target or constraint is missing.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Ask one focused blocking question containing the missing fields.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.
